every_other_rule_holds: Every start advance holds (the starts step by 4 and none overflows), and the order, ordinals, filemark counts, dense files and equal counts hold. Image level is impossible: EOD is the position after C's trailing filemark, and if it overflows that position is unrepresentable, so the trailing-filemark and EOD measurements (Sections 10.6, 12.6) cannot agree with any device report.

mutation.inputs: the five tuples with starts 2^64−20, 2^64−16, 2^64−12, 2^64−8, 2^64−4 and counts 3 (files 1..5), expected_eod_lba any

quotes: EOD is the start of C plus C's record count plus one filemark.
